title: Patient Financial Services Policy: Extension Months Earned by a Patient Payment Plans Add-On
content:
This section of the Patient Financial Services policy fixes the number of months by which an add-on lengthens the term of a Patient Payment Plans plan.

**7.1 Add-on counted.** The add-on counted is the add-on enrollment entry booked on the plan on the handling date.

**7.2 Add-on share.** The add-on share is the add-on amount divided by 6 times the plan's current installment, the current installment being the monthly installment the plan shows on the handling date.

**7.3 Extension months.** The extension granted with an add-on is the add-on share rounded down to whole months.

**7.4 Room left.** The total extension never exceeds the room left, which is the tier's maximum term-extension months less the extension months the plan has already used, and it is never below 0. The tier's maximum is the figure in the servicing limits of the Patient Payment Plans.

**7.5 Financial Hardship Plan.** On the Financial Hardship Plan an add-on restarts the term instead and earns no extension; the extension months are 0.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Item | Plan A | Plan B |
|---|---|---|
| Add-on booked on the handling date | 1,600.00 | 1,600.00 |
| Current installment | 120.00 | 120.00 |
| 6 times the current installment | 720.00 | 720.00 |
| Add-on share | 2.22 (1,600.00 divided by 720.00) | 2.22 |
| Rounded down to whole months | 2 | 2 |
| Tier maximum less months already used | 6 less 0 is 6 | 6 less 5 is 1 |
| Extension months | 2 | 1 |

An add-on of 500.00 against a current installment of 120.00 gives a share of 0.69, rounded down to 0; the extension months are 0.
